problem: Powerhouse 50 was merged and verified on main, but Netlify production remained on an older deploy because the Git-linked production pipeline had previously failed on a pricing build-script parse error.
root_cause: The feature itself was healthy. Production lag was inherited from a separate Netlify build failure; after that parser defect was fixed, a canonical Production Source Snapshot refresh was still required to promote current main.
prevention: Distinguish feature regression from inherited production-provider lag before changing feature code.
Use the canonical Production Source Snapshot OIDC-to-Netlify path for current-main promotion instead of ad-hoc deploys.
Require exact release.json commit_ref, production context, deploy_id and browser readback before LIVE_BEWEZEN.
Keep one canonical promotion obligation; close duplicate promotion lanes.
secondary_root_cause: The promotion lane exposed an existing public-i18n regression: unprefixed public routes translated in place instead of navigating to canonical static localized routes. This violated the established pricing-i18n prevention contract.
prevention_rule: undefined Public language switches outside the portal must navigate via localizedHref to static localized routes; only portal flows may use in-place translation.
